information:
The winner of Pyraminx will be declared as the winner of the competition.
There is no on-spot registration.
Participation limit is 60, so register as soon as possible.
Registration closes either on July 13, 2018, 11:59 PM IST or when registration count reaches 60 (whichever comes first)
[Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheChoiceCubeOpen2018/register) to register.
